title: Convert TutorPermissions to @freezed instead of hand-writing ==/hashCode
why: coding-standards.md is explicit: domain value objects must be `@freezed` with generated `==`/`hashCode`/`copyWith`, specifically because hand-rolled equality drifts from the field list. TutorPermissions — its own doc-comment calls it 'Immutable value object' / 'VO' — hand-writes both operators across 9 fields, plus a separately hand-written constructor, copyWith, toFirestore, and fromFirestore: 5 places a future field addition must be updated by hand. The drift risk is already visible today: `canMarkLiveCompletion` is deliberately excluded from both `==` and `hashCode` (harmless only because it is hardcoded false for every instance) — exactly the kind of silent omission @freezed generation would make structurally impossible.
recommendation: Convert TutorPermissions to a @freezed class (keeping canMarkLiveCompletion as a computed getter rather than a constructor field, or a private default so it can't be set), and delete the hand-written ==/hashCode/copyWith.
acceptance_criteria: TutorPermissions.freezed.dart is generated; no hand-written operator == or hashCode remains in tutor_permissions.dart.
Existing TutorPermissions unit tests (defaults/readOnly/toFirestore round-trip) still pass unmodified.
